proposed_decisions: \operatorname{lfp}: registry row (P4 legacy) is the same constructor; this chapter writes the source's bold \mathbf{lfp}/\mathbf{gfp}/\mathbf{pfp} for formula constructors and roman lfp(F)/gfp(F) for lattice operations; bridge stated in def:p03-w03-p03-059-lfp.
\operatorname{gfp}(F): same role as the existing P9 row (greatest fixed point of a monotone map); scope local.
\operatorname{cl}(F) closure ordinal vs P17 cl_X consequence operator: different roles, non-overlapping scopes.
\overline X complement vs P15 sample-mean overlines: different roles, non-overlapping scopes.

\mathrm{Pos}[\sigma], |a|_F, \le_F, <_F, le/lt/in/out/MAX: local to def:p03-w03-p03-059-simultaneous-lfp / def:p03-w03-p03-059-rank; 060 uses |a|_phi and \le^{inf}_phi for the inflationary analogue (different scope).
